messages:
sarah: Heads-up — after we expanded audit-log retention to 90d, I'm seeing GPU warm-pool joins fail intermittently. Keystore decrypts spike during node bootstrap and some nodes never finish join. Investigating logs now.
ajay: Confirmed — decrypt QPS to keystore up ~30% during warm-pool events. NAT gateway egress and conntrack counts spiked in ap-south and eu-west-1. Also a bunch of S3 exporter retries piling up.
leo: Which firewall changes rolled recently in those regions?
matt: I shipped fw/hardening v3.2 last night (applied default-deny outbound for hosts). It was intended to tighten egress but I didn't update the keystore allowlist. infra-bot shows the deploy at 2026-03-20T02:01Z.
infra-bot: deploy: fw/hardening v3.2 by matt — success — 2026-03-20T02:01Z :white_check_mark:
ajay: That default-deny is probably preventing keystore fallback over privatelink, forcing clients to retry via NAT which explodes cost and conntrack. Short-term mitigation: temporarily open egress for the keystore subnet(s) and lower the audit exporter sampling rate to reduce QPS.
sarah: Can we be specific — which SG rule to change and what sampling target? We need something swoop-and-fix so onboarding GPUs recover.
ajay: Propose: revert outbound deny on SG sg-0a1b2c3d for 1hr for 10.0.123.0/24 (keystore privnet) and set audit sampler to 10% (was 100%). Expected decrypt QPS reduction ~65-75%. Also watch NAT egress cost metric. CLI to add allow rule quickly:
```bash
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.0.123.0/24 --region ap-south-1
```
And to set sampler (k8s configmap patch):
```bash
kubectl -n infra patch configmap/audit-exporter -p '{"data":{"sampling_pct":"10"}}'
```
leo: Cost impact estimate?
ajay: NAT egress jumped ~$2.4k/day in ap-south during the peak. Sampling to 10% drops that ~70% in our sim. Also reduces conntrack pressure which helps kube-proxy stability and GPU join churn.
matt: I can open the SG for the keystore CIDR in ap-south AZ-a and AZ-b as a canary for 1h, then monitor metrics: keystore.decrypt.qps, gpu.join.success_rate, nat.egress_bytes. Will revert if no improvement.
sarah: Please also add a short allowlist for exporter S3 endpoints (presigned PUTs) so retries don't call KMS unnecessarily — follow-up PR to infra-config repo.
matt: noted — creating PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-config/pull/482 (WIP).
ops-oncall: I'll watch and roll back if gpu.join_success_rate doesn't increase within 30m after the SG change. Ping me with @ops-oncall when you flip it.
ajay: Also recommend a medium-term fix: update exporter to use presigned S3 uploads and increase keystore privatelink capacity, plus a sampled-logging mode default. I'll write a brief runbook.
sarah: Agreed. After canary we should schedule a retro with cost numbers and a firm timeline for exporter changes. For now do the canary + sampler change.
matt: flipping canary in 5m, will post when done.
ops-oncall: :eyes: standing by.
sarah: thanks all :thumbsup:
